require 'net/http'
require 'uri'
require 'rss'

# Invoked: fetch_feed(url: "https://news.yahoo.com/rss")
# Active contract: fetch and parse RSS/Atom feeds from any URL
# Deliverable: {items: [...], feed_title: string, provenance: {...}}

# Issue: calling .content on String objects when RSS elements are already strings
# Fix: remove .content calls when not needed, use consistent extraction pattern

url_string = kwargs[:url]

unless url_string
  result = Agent::Outcome.error(
    error_type: "missing_parameter",
    error_message: "url parameter is required",
    retriable: false
  )
  return result
end

begin
  uri = URI.parse(url_string)
  
  # Fetch the feed
  response = Net::HTTP.get_response(uri)
  
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    result = Agent::Outcome.error(
      error_type: "http_error",
      error_message: "HTTP #{response.code}: #{response.message}",
      retriable: response.code.to_i >= 500,
      http_status: response.code.to_i
    )
    return result
  end
  
  feed_content = response.body
  
  # Parse the RSS/Atom feed
  feed = RSS::Parser.parse(feed_content, false)
  
  unless feed
    result = Agent::Outcome.error(
      error_type: "parse_error",
      error_message: "Failed to parse RSS/Atom feed",
      retriable: false
    )
    return result
  end
  
  # Helper to safely extract text from RSS elements
  def extract_text(element)
    return nil if element.nil?
    return element.content if element.respond_to?(:content)
    element.to_s
  end
  
  # Extract items
  items = []
  feed_title = nil
  
  if feed.respond_to?(:items)
    # RSS 2.0
    feed.items.each do |item|
      items << {
        title: extract_text(item.title),
        link: extract_text(item.link),
        description: extract_text(item.description),
        pub_date: item.pubDate&.to_s
      }
    end
    feed_title = extract_text(feed.channel&.title)
  elsif feed.respond_to?(:entries)
    # Atom
    feed.entries.each do |entry|
      link_href = entry.link.respond_to?(:href) ? entry.link.href : extract_text(entry.link)
      items << {
        title: extract_text(entry.title),
        link: link_href,
        description: extract_text(entry.summary),
        pub_date: entry.updated&.to_s || entry.published&.to_s
      }
    end
    feed_title = extract_text(feed.title)
  else
    result = Agent::Outcome.error(
      error_type: "unsupported_feed_format",
      error_message: "Feed format not recognized (expected RSS or Atom)",
      retriable: false
    )
    return result
  end
  
  # Build provenance envelope
  provenance = {
    sources: [
      {
        uri: url_string,
        fetched_at: Time.now.utc.iso8601,
        retrieval_tool: "rss_reader",
        retrieval_mode: "live"
      }
    ]
  }
  
  result = Agent::Outcome.ok(
    items: items,
    feed_title: feed_title,
    provenance: provenance
  )
  
rescue URI::InvalidURIError => e
  result = Agent::Outcome.error(
    error_type: "invalid_url",
    error_message: "Invalid URL: #{e.message}",
    retriable: false
  )
rescue RSS::Error => e
  result = Agent::Outcome.error(
    error_type: "parse_error",
    error_message: "RSS parse error: #{e.message}",
    retriable: false
  )
rescue StandardError => e
  result = Agent::Outcome.error(
    error_type: "unknown_error",
    error_message: "Unexpected error: #{e.message}",
    retriable: true
  )
end
